tests.name: EditProductForm shows the current description's character count
EditProductForm updates the character count live as the user types
EditProductForm uses the singular form when there is exactly 1 character
Product list row actions menu has a Duplicate action that links to the duplicate route
getRouteMap product detail routes registers /products/:id/edit as its own lazy route
getRouteMap product detail routes registers /products/:id/duplicate as its own lazy route
getRouteMap product detail routes registers /products/:id/edit-all as its own lazy route
getRouteMap product detail routes keeps duplicate and edit-all as separate sibling routes
ProductTitleCell AC1: shows a Bundle badge next to the title of a bundle product
ProductTitleCell AC2: shows no badge for a regular product

config._comment: Issue #122 mutation testing (D6). Run from this directory: node ../../../node_modules/.bin/stryker run. The dashboard's tests run on Vitest, so this uses the Vitest runner, not Jest. inPlace and a repo-root temp dir follow the shared stryker.config.mjs. Point jsonReporter.fileName at -after.json for the re-run.
